tasks.name: Deterministic test_transient_failure_then_success_completes (maintenance)
tasks.objective: Remove the timing dependence in tests/app/test_practice_set.py::test_transient_failure_then_success_completes without changing the practice engine.
tasks.notes: Observed: dev CI run 40534292823 attempt 1 failed, rerun passed (2026-10-27). Cause: FlakyLlm keeps one shared counter of 6 forced 502s under the FakeLlm lock; parallel slots draw from it in scheduling order, so slot 0 may receive no failure and the assertion slots[0].requests[0]['status']=='unavailable' fails. Repro: run the test in a loop (pytest --count / for loop) under CPU load. Proposed fix: assert that some slot recorded an 'unavailable' request and that the 6 failures are all accounted for across slots, or key the failures to slot 0's prompt. Out of scope: practice-engine changes; CI pull_request trigger for dev is a separate improvement.
